profile.summaryJa: トラの子孫の家長たちの一人で、勇士とされます。ダビデの時代の人数は二万二千六百人と記されています。

sources.title: World English Bible · 1CH 7:2

primaryWitnesses.text: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
